coordinates.object_orientation: Set lower preserved extremity at z=0, overall growth +Z; show PlateII Fig9 recognizable hook/contact outline toward front camera -Y. Hidden depth smoothly inferred without diagnostic invention.

concept.reason: Actual paired-valve photograph and scale label are enough for bounded fossil interpretation; no concept images needed.

taxon: Caprina sp. (IGM-6448; historical cf. C. douvillei in 1994, identified C. massei in 1997 thesis)
primary_specimen: IGM-6448, sample JP-91-264, Plate II Fig9 of Pantoja-Alor et al.1994; both valves, posterior view as identified in 1997 thesis

context.locality: Comburindio Formation, Turitzio near Huetamo, Michoacan, Mexico

scope: One actual paired-valve fossil. Preserve curved free valve and attached elongated valve as Fig9. No borrowed shells or whole-species life reconstruction. Public genus-level identification retains documented species reassignment history.

scale.basis: Fig9 is labelled x1. Letter-sized scan suggests approximately 55-65mm total height and 45-55mm width. These are scan-derived rounded working dimensions, NOT direct caliper measurements. Depth35mm is inferred from oblique form.
scale.uncertainty: Scan resampling/original print size uncertain; do not claim exact60mm specimen. No unseen basal extension.

required_features: Two unequal valves, not a gastropod or single ammonite spiral. Broad upper/free valve bends into a descending hook; attached lower valve continues down asymmetrically.
Match ONLY Plate II Fig9 silhouette and visible contact. Do not borrow enormous Praecaprina in Fig1 or Offneria in Fig12.
Open external hook concavity is readable; it is not an internal shell aperture. Maintain plausible contact between valves, no floating pieces.
Rough fossil shell with restrained growth undulations and chipped/truncated ends consistent with photograph. No polished nacre, invented soft tissue or unsupported anatomical canals.
Retain limited coil seen in Fig9, not the full multiwhorl C.adversa spiral from unrelated specimen.
Keep preserved lower valve length; original planning phrase long attached lower valve does not authorize extending missing fossil parts.
forbidden: Other species geometry mixed into reference
Invented long taper beyond photographed lower tip
Standalone stone base, labels or ground in GLB
